notes.title: RIDE - Patch #2
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i58.tinypic.com/4vphms.jpg[/IMG]

Dear Gamers,

We apologize for the issues you were facing in the last weeks, we’re now happy to inform you that we’ve just released a patch to solve them.

[b]You can find below the changelog:[/b]

- Vast number of fixes on 3D Bikes: custom parts, textures, materials.
- Physics tweaking on three bikes: Honda RC30, Honda RC45 and Yamaha FZR750 OW01.
- Added the option to replay intro movies of bike categories.
- Online starting grid menu no more remains during race.
- Visual and physics tweaking for many DLC bikes.
- Online stability improvements.
- Various minor fixes.

Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/345660/discussions/0/618457398964899602/ ]Bug Thread[/url]

Continue to follow us on: 

- [url=https://www.facebook.com/RideGame] Facebook [/url]

- [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly] Twitter [/url] [b] hashtag #ridevideogame [/b]

notes.title: RIDE - Pre-Purchase Offer
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers!

Did you enjoy the [b]Demo[/b]?

[img]http://i58.tinypic.com/2zs8kue.png[/img]

Don't forget to [b]pre-purchase RIDE[/b] to receive the [b]Yamaha 2015 Bike Models DLC[/b]!!

The [b]Yamaha 2015 Bike Models[/b] contains the apex of [b]Yamaha [/b]technology in 2015, featuring: the new generation [b]YZF-R1[/b] created without compromises, that offers amazing performances, unprecedented control and technology that comes directly from the MotoGP™; the [b]YZF-R1M[/b], a limited edition developed for professional teams and expert riders that seek the most evolved performances on track and during races; and the [b]R6[/b], forged on the international racing circuits, utilizing technology derived from MotoGP™ and developed to guarantee exceptional performance worthy of a real professional rider.

[b]Yamaha R1 2015:[/b]

•	Displacement: 998cc
•	Maximum power: 147.1 kW (200.0 CV) @ 13.500 rpm
•	Maximum torque: 112.4 Nm (11.5 kg-m) @ 11.500 rpm
•	Wet weight (including full oil and fuel tank): 199 Kg
 
[b]Yamaha R1M 2015:[/b]

•	Displacement: 998cc
•	Maximum power: 147.1 kW (200.0 CV) @ 13.500 rpm
•	Maximum torque: 112.4 Nm (11.5 kg-m) @ 11.500 rpm
•	Wet weight (including full oil and fuel tank): 200 Kg
 
[b]Yamaha R6 2015:[/b]

•	Displacement: 599 cc
•	Maximum power: 91.0 kW (123.7 CV) @ 14.500 rpm
•	Maximum torque: 65.7 Nm (6.7 kg-m) @ 10.500 rpm
•	Wet weight (including full oil and fuel tank): 189 Kg

Enjoy [b]RIDE[/b]!

Follow us on the [url=https://www.facebook.com/RideGame]Official Facebook page[/url], and follow the Tweets on [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly]@MilestoneItaly[/url]


[url=http://milestone.it/?lang=en]Milestone Team[/url]

notes.title: Pimp your bike
notes.notes:
Hi gamers!

We are happy to announce the new Ride’s most important feature: [b]customization[/b]!

[img]http://ridevideogame.com/wp-content/uploads/ride-game-custom-parts.jpg[/img]

Over [b]100 items of clothing[/b] for men and women. [b]20 bike upgrade packs[/b], and [b]a wide range of styles[/b] for your RIDE-AVATAR. These are just some of the features that make RIDE the game that every motorcycle enthusiast, and every gamer who loves bikes, has always dreamed of getting their hands on. RIDE players can customise:

[b]STYLES[/b]
Choose the gender of your Rider, from male and female avatars, choose their haircut, and their style: from full racing gear for the experts, to jeans and a t-shirt for a more casual chic look.

[b]RIDER[/b]
Choose your favourite clothing from a wide selection of items, including: Helmets, Visors, Suits, Boots, Gloves, Jeans, and Jackets, all officially licensed gear. Impress other riders with your style, and blow your friends away by recreating your real motorcycle gear in-game and then beating them to the finish line.

[b]BIKES[/b]
The bike is the focal point of RIDE, and the bike Upgrade Packs are an essential part of the experience: use them to stay ahead of the pack. Upgrade the engine, transmission, brake system, suspension system, wheels, and look of your bike. The changes you make don't just alter the bike's appearance, they influence the bike's performance on the track, and in some cases - such as the exhaust system - the sound of your bike as you roar around the track. In order to maintain the high level of realism, the changes and customisable features available reflect each individual manufacturer's official options.

All the game items used for Rider and Bike customisation are accessible right from the start of the game. They can be acquired through a simple system of earning Credits. This virtual currency can be earned in any game mode, both online and offline.

The customisation possibilities are endless. For the hardcore motorcycle fans out there, the Milestone Team have developed a range of options to change your Rider's position on the Bike, accessible from the Riding Style menu. Recreate your own real riding style down to the last detail through a series of indicators - lateral and frontal head angle, shoulder position, seat position, inside knee position and so on - and then capture those magic moments with the Photo Mode, to share images of your avatar in action with your friends, and your rivals.

Follow us on the [url=https://www.facebook.com/RideGame]Official Facebook page[/url], and follow the Tweets on [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly]@MilestoneItaly[/url]

[url=http://milestone.it/?lang=en]Milestone Team[/url]

notes.title: Milan borrows its street to Ride
notes.notes:
Hi gamers!

We're excited to announce a new Ride's track, soon you'll play and ride on [b]Milano[/b] streets!

[img]https://scontent-mxp.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpf1/t31.0-8/10658806_1575656209370791_6747945614312426600_o.jpg[/img]

Watch the trailer on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VP1IYIJqPdQ]Official YouTube channel[/url]!

[b]MILAN:[/b] The city of Milan gives its streets over to the pure adrenalin of competitive motorcycling, on a series of tracks that allow riders to race past the city's historic palazzos and monuments. Landmarks include: the [b]Corso Como Arch[/b], situated at the centre of Milan's thriving social life; the [b]Milano Centrale Station[/b], the historic building that houses Italy's second largest and second busiest railway station, featuring over 11,000 square metres of polished marble; the [b]Unicredit Palazzo[/b]; the [b]Pirelli Tower[/b]; and the modernist [b]Palazzo Lombardia[/b]. The Milan city track has three variants: two 3 km circuits, and one 4 km circuit, offering players the unprecedented opportunity of experiencing the thriving Mediterranean city from the seat of their own motorcycle. All the environments and circuits have been faithfully recreated by the Milestone team, who took to the streets of the city in person and studied them in minute detail to create a realistic and compelling environment for players all over the world.


Follow us on the [url=https://www.facebook.com/RideGame]Official Facebook page[/url], and follow the Tweets on [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly]@MilestoneItaly[/url]

Today we officially defined the minimum and recommended PC system requirements:

[b]Minimum:[/b]

•	OS: Windows Vista SP2 / Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 8 / Windows 8.1
•	Processor:  Intel Core i3-530 @ 2.93 GHz / AMD Phenom II X4 810 @ 2.60 GHz 
•	Memory: 4 GB
•	Graphic: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 @ 1GB / ATI Radeon HD 6790 @ 1GB* 
•	Hard Drive: 35 GB
•	DirectX: 10
•	Network: Broadband Internet connection

notes.title: A new bike manufacturer has been announced: Lightning
notes.notes:
Hi gamers!

We're excited to announce a new Ride's bike manufacturer, [b]Lightning LS-218[/b]!

[img]http://ridevideogame.com/wp-content/uploads/Lightning-bike.jpg[/img]

Watch the unveiled on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yf8O-NJ_e8U&feature=youtu.be] YouTube Official channel [/url]

[b]Lightning LS-218:[/b] A new, extreme, electrically-powered bike from the USA: 228 Nm of torque, weighing in at 225 kg, Brembo brakes, and a top speed of over 185 mph. The LS-218 is the ‘production’ version of the first electric bike to break through the 200 mph threshold, a feat achieved on the legendary Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, where the 218 earned its name from the top speed of 218 mph reached by the prototype bike on that occasion. The model already boasts an impressive reputation on the track, participating in the TTCPX series, the Le Mans 24 Hours, and the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. The Lightning LS-218 is powered by a liquid-cooled permanent magnet electric engine, delivering 200 hp and 168 Nm of torque. The LS-218 uses high-grade components, with Ohlins suspension, Brembo brakes and forged magnesium Marchesini wheel rims.

notes.title: The energy of the land of the Rising Sun comes in Ride
notes.notes:
Hi gamers!

We're excited to announce a new Ride's track, soon you'll play and ride on [b]Sportsland SugoGP[/b]!

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-h-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xpf1/t31.0-8/10993476_1572258619710550_2236977511143158963_o.jpg[/img]

Watch the trailer on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fnXDG0mEfrM&feature=youtu.be]Official YouTube channel[/url]!

[b]SPORTSLAND SUGO:[/b] is located in a beautiful rural setting, with more than 2.1 million square meters. It offers four specialized racing courses – a road racing course, a motocross course, West course and a trials course. It is owned by Yamaha and the track follows the natural contours of the hill it is built on, with all the variations in height that entails. It’s very popular with circuit fans as the “Holy Site” for Motor Sports in Tohoku. 
For more information please visit the [url=http://www.sportsland-sugo.jp/en/index.html]Ride Official website[/url].
